question: Will Bitcoin reach $67,500 in July?
resolution_criteria:
This market will immediately resolve to "Yes" if any Binance 1 minute candle for BTC/USDT during the month specified in the title (from 00:00 AM ET on the first day to 11:59 PM ET on the last), has a final High price equal to or greater than the price specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the BTC/USDT High prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/BTC_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" for one-minute candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance BTC/USDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.

# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't confirm Binance's exact BTC/USDT July high, but no source I found dated on or before July 17 shows BTC near $67,500 this month. The highest reported level is about $65,100 to $66,000, on July 15. At forecast close BTC was around $63,000 to $64,000, so it needs a further rise of about 5 to 7% by July 31.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-07-17: I tried to pull Binance BTC/USDT daily candles through the Binance API, but the proxy refused the connection. Pages from CoinDesk, Fool, crypto.news, Bitcoin Foundation and StartupHub also failed to load, so the figures below come from search-result summaries.
- 2026-07-17: Fortune reported BTC at about $62,942 at 6:00 AM ET, down $1,113 from the morning before. That is after the forecast closed at 04:22 UTC (00:22 ET), but on the cutoff date. YCharts lists about $63,792 for July 17 (midnight UTC). [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-17-2026/), [YCharts](https://ycharts.com/indicators/bitcoin_price)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing so far settles the question. The highest July print I found is on July 15, and two sources disagree on its size:
  - Bitcoin Foundation: BTC briefly topped $65,000 for the first time since June 22, with a high of about $65,100. [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/bitcoin/btc-price-july-15/)
  - PrimeXBT: price was rejected near $66,000 on July 15, and every attempt higher this month has stalled in that zone. [PrimeXBT](https://primexbt.com/market-research/bitcoin-presses-the-resistance-that-has-capped-it-all-month-as-etf-inflows-return-these-are-the-key-levels-to-watch/)
- 2026-07-01: The month opened near $58,278, so the low so far is about $58,000 to $58,300. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-01-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-16: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $79M net (IBIT about $33M). That made five straight inflow sessions worth about $727M. [TFTC](https://www.tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows/july-2026), [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/crypto-etfs-news/btc-price-bitcoin-etfs/)
- 2026-07-16: BTC was about $64,055 at 5:45 AM ET, roughly 46% below a year earlier. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-16-2026/)
- 2026-07-15: A softer US CPI report (reported as -0.4% month on month, 3.5% year on year) set off a rally, and BTC neared or briefly topped $65,000. CoinDesk said the rally later cooled, with oil prices clouding the outlook. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/07/15/crypto-market-today-july-15-bitcoin-nears-usd65-000-as-crypto-rallies-on-softer-inflation-data/), [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/daybook-us/2026/07/15/bitcoin-rally-cools-as-investors-digest-inflation-data-oil-clouds-outlook)
- 2026-07-13: Renewed US-Iran hostilities pushed BTC lower, though ETF flows still showed demand. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/daybook-us/2026/07/13/resurgent-u-s-iran-hostilities-send-bitcoin-lower-even-as-etf-flows-show-demand)
- 2026-07-06 and 2026-07-10: Morning prices were about $61,935 and $64,341. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-10-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- Late June 2026: BTC hit a 21-month low near $58,000 (about June 25). June closed at about $58,559, down roughly 20% for the month, and spot ETFs saw about $4B of outflows, reported as the worst month on record. [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/learn/bitcoin-price-predictions-expert-forecasts), [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/price-bitcoin-june-2026)
- One source says BTC has been capped near $66,000 for about 50 days. The last trades above $66,000 were around mid-June (June 17), and May 31 was near $74,000. [99Bitcoins](https://99bitcoins.com/news/presales/btc-usd-65k-resistance-etf-inflows/)
- The gap to cover is $67,500 against about $63,000 to $64,000, or roughly +5.5 to 7% in about 14.5 days. So far in July, BTC has ranged about 12% from low to high ($58.3k to $65.1-66k). A two-week move of 5 to 7% in BTC is common, but $67,500 sits above resistance that has held for weeks.
- I could not find implied volatility (DVOL) figures for this period.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs a market called "What price will Bitcoin hit in July?". StartupHub write-ups (undated in the results) said $67,500 was the most-traded strike, at about 61.5% in one piece and 78.5% in another. Those odds look high next to the price data, may come from early July or another snapshot, and I could not verify them. [StartupHub](https://www.startuphub.ai/news/polymarket-bets-on-bitcoin-s-july-2026-trajectory), [StartupHub 2](https://www.startuphub.ai/news/bitcoin-price-bets-july-2026)
- The same coverage put downside strikes at about 3.1% for $57,500 and 2.1% for $55,000.
- I could not get Polymarket's live price for the $67,500 strike as of July 17, or any matching Kalshi or Manifold prices.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-07-28/29: the FOMC meeting, the main scheduled macro catalyst. The 2026 calendar puts the July meeting on these dates. [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/bitcoin-price-prediction-july-2026-fed-decides/)
- Ongoing: whether the ETF inflow streak continues, US-Iran geopolitics and oil prices, and whether BTC can break the $66,000 resistance.
- 2026-07-31 11:59 PM ET: the window closes.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I couldn't confirm a Binance BTC/USDT high of $67,500 or more in July as of July 16-17, 2026. The highest July price I found was about $65,100 on July 14-15, and on July 16 BTC closed near $63,800. To reach the target it would need to rise about 5.8% before July 31, 11:59 PM ET.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't retrieve Binance data: both the Binance API and the StatMuse page were refused by the proxy, so I have no Binance 1-minute high. All prices below are from aggregators (roughly USD index), not Binance BTC/USDT.
- 2026-07-16: StatMuse's daily figures were open $64,713, high $64,932, low $63,702, close $63,789. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/bitcoin-price-day-by-day-july-2026)
- 2026-07-16: BTC opened at $64,720 (Yahoo Finance). Fortune had it at $64,055 at 5:45 a.m. ET. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-thursday-july-16-2026-prices-rise-ethereum-becomes-increasingly-compelling-124218108.html), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-16-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The July high I found was about $65,100, roughly $2,400 (3.7%) below the target. Spot near $63,800 is about 5.8% below it.
- 2026-07-03: BTC opened at $61,493. [Biztoc/Yahoo](https://biztoc.com/x/663908b56c1f085c)
- 2026-07-06: BTC was about $61,935. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-06-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-16: Prices were slipping after the CPI spike. Yahoo's headline called Ethereum "increasingly compelling". [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-thursday-july-16-2026-prices-rise-ethereum-becomes-increasingly-compelling-124218108.html)
- 2026-07-14/15: The June CPI report showed prices down 0.4% for the month, the biggest drop since April 2020. Annual inflation fell to 3.5%, against a 3.8% forecast. BTC jumped from about $62,000 to $64,900 within minutes and peaked near $65,100, its first move above $65,000 since June 22. Reports put resistance near $66,000. ETF outflows and US-Iran tensions were cited as headwinds. [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/bitcoin/btc-price-july-15/), [Forklog](https://forklog.com/en/bitcoin-holds-above-65000-following-u-s-inflation-slowdown/?hl=en-US), [BeInCrypto](https://beincrypto.com/us-cpi-report-bitcoin-pump-or-dump-july-2026/)
- Early July 2026: US spot BTC ETFs had 8 straight weeks of net outflows, about $5.53B year to date, with more than $4B leaving in June alone. There was an inflow of about $221.7M on July 2. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/bitcoin-etfs-record-5-53-billion-outflows-in-2026)
- 2026-07-02: BTC started the year above $93,000 but ended June around $60,000. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/07/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-for-july-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- June 2026 was down about 20.5%, the worst month of 2026. The trend is bearish, with a bounce from about $60,000 to $65,000 so far in July.
- Over July 1-16, the range was roughly $60,000-61,000 (low) to $65,100 (high), about 7-8% from low to high.
- To resolve Yes, BTC needs an intramonth high about 5.8% above the July 16 close, within about 15 days. Historically, BTC's maximum upside move over 2-week windows often exceeds 5-6%, especially after a month with about 20% swings. However, the $65,000-66,000 level has acted as resistance. I did not find a computed base-rate statistic.

## 5. Other forecasts
- A StartupHub piece about Polymarket's "What price will Bitcoin hit in July" market says $67.5k was the most heavily weighted level. Its numbers are inconsistent: one version says about 61.5%, another says 78.5%. I couldn't verify the timestamp or the live Polymarket price as of July 17. [StartupHub](https://www.startuphub.ai/news/bitcoin-price-bets-july-2026)
- A Polymarket mirror showed the $66,000 upside contract for July 6-12 at about 30%. [mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-july-6-12-2026/)
- 2026-07-02: Monthly outlooks were published by 24/7 Wall St and CryptoTimes. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/07/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-for-july-2026/), [CryptoTimes](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/07/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-july-2026-will-btc-go-up-or-crash/)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold price for this exact question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-07-28/29: The FOMC meets, with the decision on July 29 at 2:00 PM ET. This is the main scheduled macro catalyst. After the soft CPI print, markets may watch for signs of rate cuts. [Babypips](https://www.babypips.com/analysis/event-guide-forex-us-fomc-statement-july-2026-07-29), [Fed calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-july.htm)
- Ongoing: daily ETF flows and US-Iran geopolitical headlines.
- 2026-07-31 11:59 PM ET: the July window closes.

- July so far has already ranged about 12% from low to high.

For No:
- The $65,000 to $66,000 zone has capped price for about 50 days; the July 15 attempt was rejected there.
- July 16-17: the CPI rally faded to about $63,800, and about $62,900 by the morning of July 17.
- June fell about 20% with record ETF outflows, so the broader trend is bearish.
- US-Iran tensions and oil prices remain headwinds.
- The reported Polymarket odds (61.5% and 78.5%) are undated, inconsistent with each other and unverifiable, so I do not use them as an anchor.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- No: BTC chops between $60,000 and $66,000, with rallies sold at resistance and the FOMC failing to deliver a decisive dovish signal.
- Yes: continued ETF inflows plus a de-escalation or dovish FOMC break $66,000, and short covering carries price quickly through $67,500 in late July.

**(f) From base rate to final.** I start at about 38% and move down about 7 points. The reasons are the repeatedly tested resistance sitting between spot and the target, the post-CPI fade, and the bearish medium-term trend. Volatility is high enough that a 6 to 7% rally in two weeks is far from unlikely, so I do not go lower than that.

Probability: 31%

- **For Yes:**

  - BTC has already ranged about 12% from low to high this month, so a 6% move is well within normal volatility.
- **For No:**
  - The $65,000 to $66,000 zone has reportedly capped price for about 50 days, and the CPI rally was rejected there on July 15.
  - Price faded to about $62,900 by July 17.
  - The broader trend is bearish: June was down about 20% with record ETF outflows.
  - US-Iran tensions and oil prices are ongoing headwinds.
  - The Polymarket figures cited (61.5% and 78.5%) are undated, mutually inconsistent and unverified, so I do not use them as an anchor.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- **No:** BTC keeps chopping between $61,000 and $66,000, the FOMC holds with neutral messaging, and each rally stalls at resistance.
- **Yes:** ETF inflows continue, BTC breaks $66,000, short covering carries it quickly to $67,500 or above, possibly around a dovish FOMC or a geopolitical de-escalation.

**(f) From base rate to final.** The volatility-based estimate is about 35 to 40%. I shade down a few points for the repeated rejection at resistance, the post-CPI fade, the bearish trend and the status quo. The inflow streak and the FOMC catalyst keep it from going much lower. That lands at about 30%.

Probability: 30%
